status_note: top-n `min(x, n)` filed as [#8888](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/8888), fixed on main by [#8896](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/pull/8896) (bdaf7d1, 2026-11-04; other dialects now warn), not released. Reproduces on 30.29.0. `strftime`, `POSITIONAL`/`ASOF` and `TRY` not rechecked: SQLGlot has no DataFusion dialect.
summary: DuckDB → DataFusion transpiling rewrites some functions with another meaning: `strftime`, top-n `min(x, n)`, `POSITIONAL`/`ASOF` joins, `TRY`. Only the top-n `min`/`max` part is filed (#8888) and re-checked; the other cases were not re-checked on 2026-11-04.
